color.summary: Cool greys on white, nearly neutral: #1f2328 ink, #59636e for secondary text, #d1d9e0 borders and #f6f8fa for bands and default buttons. Blue (#0969da) is links, focus and selection; green (#1f883d) is kept for the primary action and open states; purple marks merged. Dark mode is its own palette: #0d1117 page, #f0f6fc ink, #3d444d borders, a lighter blue (#4493f8) for links.
usage: The repository header and box headers sit on the #f6f8fa band; the page stays white.

type.summary: 14px on a 21px line for most of the UI, 12px on 18px for metadata, 16px for list titles and headings (600 for headings, 500 for issue titles). Primer asks for Mona Sans, but no face loads on github.com, so the system font renders. Code and the clone URL are monospace.

shape.summary: 6px corners almost everywhere: buttons, inputs, boxes, menu rows. Dialogs and overlays round to 12px. Avatars, labels and counters are full pills.

spacing.summary: A 4px base used in 2px steps: 8px is the most common gap, then 6px and 12px, with 16px around boxes. Controls are 32px (medium) or 28px (small).

elevation.summary: Mostly flat: borders separate things, not shadows. Buttons carry a 1px drop at 4% black and inputs a faint inset at the top. Dialogs and overlays share one floating shadow: a 1px ring plus two soft layers (6px 12px and 6px 18px).

button.summary: Primer's Button, read off github.com and Primer's Storybook. The product names its looks with data-variant: default (the most used), invisible (toolbar actions), primary (green, the page's main action), danger, link and secondary. Sizes are named too: small 28px, medium 32px, large 40px. Icon-only buttons are squares at the same heights.

invisible.note: No fill at rest, grey on hover: toolbar and overflow actions.

badge.summary: Five components share this block, all full pills. Label is outlined in ten colors, named by data-variant: default, primary, secondary, accent, success, attention, severe, danger, done and sponsors. IssueLabel fills with a named color (gray, blue, green, pink and twenty more). CounterLabel is the count chip beside a tab or on a button. StateLabel is the filled open, closed or merged pill. Timeline badges, 32px circles with an icon, reuse the variant names and are left out here.

https://github.com/mehdibha/dotUI.title: Repository
https://github.com/mehdibha/dotUI.summary: A repository's front page, signed out: the black global header, the repository header on a grey band with its tab bar, then the files and README beside a sidebar.
layout: Global header 72px, black in both modes; the repository header under it is 100px, a #f6f8fa band (#010409 in dark) closed by a 1px rule.
Content is 1216px wide at x112: a 904px column for the files and README, and a 272px sidebar 40px to its right.
Tabs, toolbar controls and file rows share 32px heights and 6px corners.
A 114px footer of small links closes the 3196px page.

https://github.com/mehdibha/dotUI/issues.title: Issues
https://github.com/mehdibha/dotUI/issues.summary: The issue list in its newer layout: a navigation sidebar on the page's left edge and one wide list beside it.
layout: Sidebar 256px wide, flush to the left edge and 728px tall.
The list column starts at x280, 24px after the sidebar, and runs to 24px from the right edge (1136px).
A single 32px filter input heads the column; rows are 65px.
The footer is 59px here, against 114px on the repository page.

https://github.com/mehdibha/dotUI/pulse.title: Pulse
https://github.com/mehdibha/dotUI/pulse.summary: Repository insights: a side menu and a column of reports, each report a bordered box.
layout: The repository page's 1216px frame: a 296px menu at x112 and an 896px report column at x432, 24px to its right.
Reports are 6px boxes with a 1px #d1d9e0 border; the overview's header is a #f6f8fa band.
The merged pull requests list makes most of the 4468px page.

https://github.com/mehdibha/dotUI/pulls.title: Pull requests
https://github.com/mehdibha/dotUI/pulls.summary: The pull request list: no sidebar, one wide column of rows under a filter input.
layout: One 1232px column at x104, 104px from each edge.
A 32px filter input at the top; rows are 67px, split by 1px rules.

https://github.com/search?q=design+syste.title: Search

global-header.title: Global header
global-header.note: The signed-out header, black in both modes: the logo, five menus that open mega-menus, a search field with a / hint, and Sign in and Sign up.

repo-header.title: Repository header
repo-header.note: Owner and name over the underline tab bar, on the #f6f8fa band. The current tab is underlined in coral (#fd8c73); counts sit in grey pills.

repo-title.title: Repository title
repo-title.note: Avatar, name and a Public label on the left; 28px Notifications, Fork and Star buttons on the right, #f6f8fa with a 1px #d1d9e0 border. The copy wraps Star onto a second line; on the page it sits in the row.

file-toolbar.title: File toolbar
file-toolbar.note: Branch select, branch and tag counts, a Go to file input and the Code button, all 32px with 6px corners. Green (#1f883d) is kept for this one primary action.

file-list.title: File list
file-list.note: A bordered box: the latest commit on a #f6f8fa header row, then 41px rows of name, last commit message and age, split by 1px #d1d9e0 rules.

readme.title: README
readme.note: A bordered box that opens on its own tab bar (README, Contributing, license) with the same coral underline. The markdown sets h1 at 32px and h2 at 24px, both at 600 over a bottom rule.

about-sidebar.title: About
about-sidebar.hide: the sidebar block holds all of it

sidebar-sections.title: Sidebar
sidebar-sections.note: About, Releases and Contributors stacked with 16px above and below each and a rule between. Topics are pills of 12px text at 600, #0969da on #ddf4ff.

site-footer.title: Footer
site-footer.note: One centred row: the mark, the copyright and small grey links.

platform-menu.title: Platform menu
platform-menu.note: The header's mega-menu: a black panel with 8px corners, a 1px #3d444d ring and a deep shadow; four columns of icon, title and one-line description over a #0f1511 footer row.

command-palette.title: Command palette
command-palette.note: Opens from the header's search field: a 480px overlay with 12px corners, the input on top and grouped Jump to rows of 33px below.

branch-picker.title: Branch picker
branch-picker.note: A 320px panel with 12px corners: a title and close button, a filter input, Branches and Tags tabs, then rows with a check on the current branch and a default label.

clone-panel.title: Clone panel
clone-panel.note: The Code button's 400px overlay: an HTTPS and GitHub CLI segmented control, a read-only monospace URL field with a copy button, then action rows.

issues-sidebar.title: Issues sidebar
issues-sidebar.note: 32px rows with 6px corners; the current one sits on a grey fill with a blue bar at its left. Groups are split by a rule, and Feedback and Collapse sidebar sit at the bottom.

issues-filter.title: Issues filter
issues-filter.note: The page title and a green New issue button over one 32px filter input that marks its qualifiers in blue.

issue-list.title: Issue list
issue-list.note: A bordered box with 6px corners: Open and Closed counts and filter menus on its header row, then 65px rows of an open icon, the title, labels as colored pills and a muted meta line, with assignees on the right.

issue-row.title: Issue row
issue-row.note: One row of the list at full size: icon, title, meta line, and the comment count on the right.

author-filter.title: Author filter
author-filter.note: A 320px filter menu from the list's header: a title, a search input, then rows of avatar, name and secondary text, the selected one marked by a blue bar. Redacted, as it lists people.

insights-nav.title: Insights menu
insights-nav.note: A bordered box of 38px rows split by rules; the current row is marked by a coral (#fd8c73) bar on its left.

pulse-overview.title: Pulse overview
pulse-overview.note: A bordered box with a #f6f8fa header: two 8px bars split pull requests (purple #8250df merged, green open) and issues, over four count tiles.

pulse-summary.title: Pulse summary
pulse-summary.note: Two 440px boxes side by side: a written summary with green additions and red deletions, and a bar chart of top committers.

merged-list.title: Merged pull requests
merged-list.note: A heading centred on a rule, then a plain list of merge icons, bold titles and a small meta line, with no boxes or dividers.

pr-row.title: Pull request row
pr-row.note: Like an issue row, 67px: state icon, title, a blue label, then a meta line with an outlined Owner pill and the check status; comments and avatar on the right.

search-filters.title: Search filters
search-filters.note: Result types with count pills, the current one on a grey fill with a blue bar, then Languages with colored dots.

repo-result.title: Repository result
repo-result.note: A bordered card with 6px corners and 16px padding: avatar and name with the matched words in bold, description, topic pills (#ddf4ff, 12px at 500) and a meta line, with a 28px Star button on the right.

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.note: Previous and Next as text links, 32px page buttons with 6px corners, the current page filled blue.

provenance.notes: Written section by section from the census (spec.json, census eb3e7cf) and its page shots; pages and blocks from blocks.json's copies of 2026-10-25 and their computed styles. Names marked ai are ours; docs names come from Primer's documentation.
